meta.scope: Iraq Batch 2 — Oil production and exports, oil-revenue fiscal dominance, and federal budget densification.

candidates.title: Crude oil production statistics
candidates.description: Official and compiled statistics on crude oil production. Production is in the mid-to-high 4 million barrels per day range in recent readings; federal and Kurdistan Region output are distinguished in detailed monitoring.
candidates.notes: Core real-sector production node. Highest-centrality commodity for Iraq.

candidates.title: Crude oil export statistics
candidates.description: Official statistics on crude oil export volumes and values from southern terminals and other outlets. Oil exports dominate merchandise exports and current-account credits.

candidates.title: Oil revenue and fiscal dependence statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Oil related
candidates.description: Statistics on oil revenues as a share of total federal budget revenue. Oil typically accounts for the large majority of public revenue (recent readings around 84% in early 2026), making the fiscal position highly sensitive to oil prices and export volumes.

candidates.title: Federal budget revenue and expenditure statistics
candidates.description: Official federal budget realization covering revenues (oil and non-oil), expenditures and the overall balance. Public-sector salaries, pensions and social allocations form a large recurrent share of spending.
candidates.notes: Core fiscal-flow node under oil dominance.

candidates.title: Iraq oil–fiscal densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from Oil Ministry and Finance Ministry sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding crude oil production, oil exports, oil-revenue fiscal dependence and federal budget statistics into a coherent oil–fiscal layer that dominates the Iraqi macro structure.
